beats.say: Six trig functions. One shape holds every relationship between them.
beats.title: ONE HEXAGON
beats.caption: six functions, one picture

beats.say: Down the left: sine, tangent, secant.
beats.title: BUILD IT
beats.caption: left side

beats.say: Down the right, their co-functions: cosine, cotangent, cosecant.
beats.caption: right side: the CO- functions

beats.say: And a one in the middle.
beats.caption: 1 in the centre

beats.say: Rule one. Opposite corners multiply to one.
beats.title: 1. RECIPROCAL
beats.caption: opposite corners multiply to 1

beats.say: Tangent times cotangent is one. Three lines, six identities.
beats.caption: tan θ · cot θ = 1
